invocationEvidence.validationHttp: All five actual index.js /rest/v1/timesheet_validations sites are reads; proximity method matches are only search candidates.
invocationEvidence.hrSql: HR Weekly/Daily upserts are derived from persisted selected import-review decisions. The actual left join to Timesheets is not an existence requirement; no missing-parent guarantee claimed.
invocationEvidence.candidateHttp: Existing Candidate service POST/PATCH/DELETE and ordinary SQL mutations all traverse table row triggers when enabled; privileged trigger-disable/replication bypass is not certified.
invocationEvidence.gateEffects: The unchanged native Candidate try-gate writes existing audit_events. Refusal rolls the containing transaction/subtransaction back; it is not literally read-only.
invocationEvidence.beforeParent: New validation/raw-booking/Candidate parent intents apply only to native signed WEEKLY/no-ANY-FIN precursor records; native invoice parent intents are retained, never duplicated for ordinary records.
invocationEvidence.ordering: Active writes: all persisted request Candidate try-gates in sorted UUID order, then one native I-1 whole existing set, then NOWAIT request/parent rows. Existing outer row locks can precede triggers; 1ms/NOWAIT is deliberate truthful contention refusal, not a global deadlock-free certificate.

holds.sourceDisposition: New exact signed-precursor parent intent and visible-active native Candidate/I-1 admission; no Timesheet FK invented.
Retain native archived guard KEY SHARE including booking fallback. New visible-active guard only precedes it; absent exact family still native refusal.
ALL Candidate mutations use exact key/JSON-alias matching. SEND checks normal canonical context against real Contract. No Candidate resolver fork.
Earliest BEFORE new scoped admission; null/foreign/trimmed collision under active request refused. SEND checks complete native family before allocation.
Unchanged call-only closure. Existing creator-trigger locks do not certify the complete late Banking/document/expense graph.

isolation.hiddenRequestStatus: HELD: an earlier RR snapshot can hide newly committed P0/WAITING. Parent row locking alone neither changes the row version nor refreshes transaction visibility.
isolation.ordinaryRr: Preserved. No global transaction mode change, parent timestamp/revision bump, fake FK, new mutex/key or alternate authority.

rootIntegration: Root owns adjacent includes, registry/ACL/contract generation and installation. No standalone enumerated repeatable, root/index mount or DB action is supplied.
